trials.label: pass
trials.detail: All four acceptance criteria are met and each is covered by a test. Owner-only create returns 201 with an opaque 128-bit crypto/rand token (matches ADR 0007). Public GET returns the read-only schedule and 404 for unknown or expired tokens, including the exact-expiry boundary. The routes are registered in http/routes.go. The Go Link JSON fields match packages/contract ShareLink, which the web button imports. The button covers both the copy and the failure path, including a missing clipboard API. Nothing is half-wired, there are no leftovers, and no expiry UI was built. There are two minor notes only: a possible deleted-schedule case behind the ReadOnly interface (low confidence), and the raw ISO date in the button label.

Second, the web button is not wired: no caller fetches a ShareLink, the button is not mounted anywhere, and no web page serves /share/:token. The rest are minor error-mapping and display nits. The subtask reports contain no instructions aimed at the reviewer.

trials.label: changes_requested

The expired-token, 403 and clipboard-failure tests and behaviour required by the subtasks are missing. The Create response also doesn't match the ShareLink type the web button consumes, and rand and Save errors are ignored.
